_note: What a hit leaves behind, per enemy kind (src/vfx/feedback.gd, particles.gd; in the story worlds through src/hero/story_feel.gd, docs/VFX-SYSTEM.de.md). material: bone (chips and dust, no liquid), slime, frost, blood, void; the Hell-Dungeon's ember, magma, ash, soul, obsidian. color: particles; stain: floor splat colour; stain_alpha: splat opacity. hit_splat and death_splat are splat radii in px; drip_below is the health share under which a wounded enemy leaves a drip trail, drip_every the px walked between drops; death_fx: the effect sheet a felled enemy bursts into (default by material in feedback.gd). Purely visual.
_splat_note: A body flung against a wall at the Leerenmagier's Urknall (src/vfx/talent_fx.gd splat -> src/vfx/particles.gd splat_burst, src/rig/rig_renderer.gd fling_near). class: a material's burst (flesh, bone, void, gold; unknown ones flesh); colours from the material above (color, stain, stain_alpha) or the class's own. flesh: drops sprayed back off the wall, chunks (chunk_colors, chunk_lift px/s) that bounce and lie, floor_splat and wall_splat px; spray px/s of the throw. bone: splinters, dust puffs, skull rolling away (skull_roll px/s), eyes its sockets. void: motes, stain_r px. gold: coins, glints. kick: how hard the loose floor pixels round it jump. fling (rig_renderer, src/rig_kit/rig_debris.gd fling): time s a fling waits for the death it tears apart, speed px/s of the parts, lift [min, max] px/s upwards, spread rad round the rebound, jitter [lo, hi] on the speed, spin rad/s either way, depth the factor on the floor's y.
_ragdoll_note: Rig debris as a ragdoll (src/rig/rig_renderer.gd): a dying enemy's snapshot kill {dx, dy, tier|talent+ult|force, el, wall} throws every part with v = dir * speed * tiers[tier] * jitter, rotated by +-spread rad, plus pop px/s outward from the body, depth scales the ground-plane y, lift px/s up times the root of the impulse, spin rad/s times the impulse; velocities scale with the rig's size (story figures). gravity px/s2; a landing faster than rest_vz bounces (bounce of vz, ground_keep of the slide, spin_keep of the spin), walls (the host's solid test) reflect wall_bounce; sliding loses friction per s; under rest_speed it lies still. radius: pieces shove each other apart (px). Settled parts stay; above cap the oldest crumble by a 4x4 dither over dither_time s. tiers: small (arrows, blows), medium, large (Feuerball), huge (ultimates: Meteor), splat (flung against a wall at the Urknall). split: families of few parts cut into pieces of piece_px source rows (most pieces). talent_element: talent id or class prefix -> element look. elements: tint (multiplier on the part), embers (pixels glowing through the flame ramp over ember_time s), rime (top-edge pixels in rime_color), shatter (pieces at the first hard landing, shatter_speed px/s, chips in chip_color), matter: particles a fresh corpse gives off (rate per s until s, colors, vx spread, vy [lo, hi], grav, life [lo, hi]). loose: a held item (weapon, shield) comes off the hand on its own path - the blow direction turned by side rad to the hand side, speed and lift as factors of a body part's, spin [min, max] rad/s either way - so it never rides with the skull at its held angle. The physics run in src/rig_kit/rig_debris.gd (RigDebris, its header lists every key): scatter [x, y] px/s of a blow without a direction; wall_spin the factor on the spin at a wall (negative turns it round); rest_spin rad/s a resting piece must be below; shove how hard a moving piece bounces off another (radius); turn_steps angles a piece turns through on its pixel grid, turn_new new turns built per frame, outline the hex of the rim on a cut edge. hero_weapon: a fallen hero's weapon (src/hero/hero_look.gd drop_weapon), in weapon pixels: thrown forward at speed and up at lift px/s turning at spin rad/s, gravity px/s2; every landing bounces (rest_vz 0) up to bounces times, keeping bounce of the fall, ground_keep of the slide and spin_keep of the spin, then the next landing stops it; lying, it eases its angle onto its flat side (snap_turn, snap_offset in turns, snap_rate per s); worked out in steps_per_s fixed steps for settle s.
